fib: ______ is a voluntary cession by the insured to the insurer of what remains in the subject-matter insured, together with all proprietary rights and remedies in respect thereof.
Abandonment
Abandonment is a voluntary cession by the insured to the insurer of what remains in the subject-matter insured, together with all proprietary rights and remedies in respect thereof.
______ is the authority which a court possesses to decide matters submitted before it for its decision.
Jurisdiction
Jurisdiction is the authority which a court possesses to decide matters submitted before it for its decision.
______ is the person(s) or company in whose name the vessel is registered.
registered owner
A registered owner is the person(s) or company in whose name the vessel is registered.
______ is the formal instrument that provides legally valid evidence of the insurance contract.
marine policy
A marine policy is the formal instrument that provides legally valid evidence of the insurance contract.
______ is a document containing the terms and conditions of the marine insurance contract between the insured and the assured.
policy
A policy is a document containing the terms and conditions of the marine insurance contract between the insured and the assured.
______ is an incident of certain legal relationships, and may arise either from contract express or implied from an obligation resulting from the relationship of the parties or statutes.
right of Indemnity

A right of Indemnity is an incident of certain legal relationships, and may arise either from contract express or implied from an obligation resulting from the relationship of the parties or statutes.
______ is the reward paid to the owner of the ship for carrying goods in his ship to the delivery port.
Ordinary freight
Ordinary freight is the reward paid to the owner of the ship for carrying goods in his ship to the delivery port.
______ means that addition to the cost of his own goods carried in his own ship which the ship owner charges at the port of delivery as the price of carriage.
owners trading freight
The owners trading freight means that addition to the cost of his own goods carried in his own ship which the ship owner charges at the port of delivery as the price of carriage.

principle of indemnity
